title: shard buhlmann
summary: A new cloud shard has an observed mean incident rate of 0.20 over 4 equal exposure periods. Across comparable shards, the collective mean is 0.05. Historical decomposition gives expected within-shard process variance EPV=0.02 and variance of hypothetical shard means VHM=0.01. The team must form the classical linear credibility estimate for the shard's next-period incident rate rather than use either mean alone.
